sources.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.

event.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer
event.summary: OpenAI agreed to acquire Pierre Computer, the developer-tools company behind Code Storage and open-source tools used in Codex. The companies will remain separate until the acquisition closes.

facts.label: Agreement
facts.text: OpenAI announced that it will acquire Pierre Computer Company.
facts.quote: Today we're announcing that OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc

facts.label: Closing conditions
facts.text: The acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
facts.quote: The closing of the acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of regulatory approvals. Until closing, OpenAI and Pierre will remain separate and independent companies.
